description: The payload an entity's domain event carries, as the components of the Java <Event>EventPayload record and the members of the generated TypeScript <Entity><Event>Payload interface. A component is a field of the event's payloadFields that the entity declares and the event does not list in sensitiveFields, in payloadFields order; an event with none sends an empty payload. EventPayloadParityE2ETest (exeris-e2e-tests) proves the generated publisher declares exactly components; event-payload-parity.spec.ts (exeris-codegen-ts) proves the generated TypeScript interface declares exactly components, with the type in tsType. Change it only together with the event publisher generator.
